title: Tensor Memory: Fixed-Size Recurrent State for Long-Horizon Transformers
core_contribution: Fixed-size recurrent 3D voxel memory tensor for Transformers; decouples state capacity from input length via continuous Gaussian write/read + ConvLSTM update
key_mechanisms: ht, ct ∈ R^(C×D×H×W) fixed-size hidden/cell state pair
Gaussian write volume: U(t) = content(t) ⊗ M(t) around μ_write with spread σ
Shared coordinate predictor for read/write coordinates in [-1,1]^3
Trilinear GridSample read with gated residual fusion: x̂ = x + σ(γ)·D(m)
Factorized 3D ConvLSTM update: depthwise DW1×1×3, DW1×3×1, DW3×1×1 + pointwise projection
Learned scalar gate γ suppresses memory path when not useful (no-harm control)

sovereign_stack_mappings.role: Wave-function persistence layer for 512-state expansion; each hex/phase is a voxel coordinate; JSON corpus files are the recurrent state; input refills via Gaussian write; consult reads via trilinear sample
integration_points: collapse_full_128() writes 512 resolved states to 8x8x8 voxel grid once; subsequent consults read cached state unless input delta exceeds threshold
Gaussian write volume deposits at mu_write = f(hex_id, phase, porosity, emotional_input) -> continuous 3D coordinate
9-bit/13-bit save-string fields are voxel channel encodings: 9-bit hex ID + 4-bit phase + 4-bit porosity + ... = fixed-width channel vector
Batch refill: new input writes new Gaussian volume; ConvLSTM update blends with existing state; no full recompute
Inversion pairs share mirrored coordinates; read/write naturally handles in/out via coordinate transform
64-domain specialization: each hex has own sub-voxel region; 3D/text/agentic/video/audio/code domains are read-head projections off shared memory
Deterministic coordinate function: mu = (hex_id/8, phase/8, porosity) maps directly to grid; no learned predictor needed

integration_points: EventBroadcasterRegistry queue replaced by 3D voxel state (subscribers read from memory tensor instead of queue)

64 hexagram slots × 8 phases = 512 fixed addresses in voxel grid

KV cache replaced by fixed-size memory; batch inference scales to arbitrary sequence length

integration_points: Cache topology encoded as 3D voxel grid (map x, y, layer)

Portal detection via memory norm peaks at house/homestead coordinates

integration_points: Zustand store backed by Tensor Memory instead of growing JS objects
64 hexagram UI states + 8 phase transitions stored in 3D voxel grid
Read/write via coordinate hooks; gated residual fusion into React components

technical_alignment.determinism: Fully deterministic when coordinate predictor is frozen or hard-coded; matches King Wen zero-roll requirement
technical_alignment.fixed_size: State capacity decoupled from input length; 512-state King Wen expansion fits in 8×8×8×C voxel grid
technical_alignment.spatial_bias: 3D voxel layout matches sovereign world topology (64 sectors × 6 yao pellets)
technical_alignment.recurrent_dynamics: ConvLSTM-style update matches emotional_engine.py phase transitions
technical_alignment.continuous_coordinates: Gaussian write/read aligns with Schauberger vortex continuous-field formulation
technical_alignment.gated_fusion: Learned γ gate matches porosity-based voice modulation threshold

implementation_priority: Phase 1: King Wen voxel memory prototype (8×8×8 grid, 512 hex states)
Phase 2: OpenJarvis event broadcaster migration to Tensor Memory
Phase 3: Megatron per-hex training with fixed recurrent state

tensor_memory_encoding.channel_width: C = 24 save-string tokens per pellet -> 24-channel voxel feature
tensor_memory_encoding.write_spread: sigma = f(yao_dy, vortex_tension, emotional_input) -> Gaussian radius per write
tensor_memory_encoding.read_coordinate: mu_read = projection of current consult vector into 3D via shared coordinate head
tensor_memory_encoding.gate_gamma: gamma = f(phase_temporal, trajectory, agree_temporal) -> suppress memory when not useful

inversion_pair_encoding.pattern: Inversion pairs share mirrored coordinates: (x,y,z) <-> (1-x,1-y,1-z) or (x,y,1-z)
inversion_pair_encoding.read_write_flow: Write to hex A reads from hex A' via coordinate mirror; in/out is natural

domain_projection.shared_memory: All 64 hexes write to same 8x8x8 grid; no per-hex separate memory
domain_projection.domain_read_heads: 3D/text/agentic/video/audio/code are learned projections W_out^domain from voxel channels to token dim
domain_projection.subdomain_split: 32-domain split = 2 hexes per subdomain via inversion pairing; each subdomain has own projection head

implementation_sequence: 1. Define voxel grid schema: 8x8x8x24, dtype float32, deterministic coordinate mapping
2. Implement Gaussian write: content otimes exp(-||G-mu||^2/(2*sigma^2+epsilon)) with sigma from yao_dy + emotional_input
3. Implement ConvLSTM update: factorized 3D DW convs + pointwise -> 4 gates -> (ht+1, ct+1)
4. Implement trilinear read: GridSample(ht, mu_read) -> W_out -> gated residual fusion
5. Wire collapse_full_128() to write-through on first call, read-on-miss on subsequent calls
6. Batch refill: new input writes new volume; ConvLSTM blends; no full recompute unless gate gamma opens
7. Verification: py_compile + deterministic replay (same input -> same voxel state) + 512-slot occupancy check
